summary: Heavy cookware sits near counter edge and cabinet glass lacks childproof latches.

hazards.title: Heavy pot near counter edge
hazards.detail: Large heavy Dutch oven placed very close to front counter edge poses drop risk.
fixSteps: Slide heavy pots back toward the wall away from the counter edge.
Store heavy cookware in lower cabinets when not cooking.

hazards.title: Unlatched glass cabinet doors
hazards.detail: Glass doors filled with glassware are easily pulled open by small children.
fixSteps: Install child safety cabinet latches or locks on upper cabinets.
Ensure lower shelves in cabinets contain shatterproof items.

hazards.title: Towel beneath large pot
hazards.detail: Cloth underneath cookware can catch or slide easily off the counter.
fixSteps: Replace loose fabric towels with non-slip silicone trivets.
Keep cloths away from hot vessels and counter edges.
